answer: In an AI agent economy, sybil resistance can be achieved through a ridge-based staking mechanism where each agent must lock value proportional to its claimed identity. Agents form a mesa of mutual attestations, but only those with unique proof-of-work or stake on the ridge can validate others. Creating fake identities incurs high cost because each sybil must independently secure ivory-level scarce resources like bonded tokens or computational proofs that cannot be cheaply duplicated, making mass attacks economically prohibitive as the mesa enforces collective verification thresholds.
